name: wotr-queller-bot
description: Queller Bot Runner for War of the Ring: sources, build script and tests

scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:md && npm run format:check
scripts.test: node test/check.js && node test/verify.js && node test/debuglog.js && node test/render.js && node test/ui.js && node test/contrast.js && node test/fuzz.js 1
scripts.coverage: c8 --src src --all --exclude test --exclude scripts --exclude build.js -r text -r lcov npm test
